entities.name: Luboš Bartoň
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luboš Bartoň is a Czech former professional basketball player and coach. During his pro club career, at a height of 2.02 m tall, he played at the small forward position. As a player, he was a member of the FIBA European Selection Team in 1998, and he won the EuroLeague championship in 2010.
